page.overview:
Who is UN Space Station?

The UN Space Station is a selectable arena in Mortal Kombat vs. DC Universe.

This orbiting satellite is the headquarters of the heroes of the DC universe (better known as the [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Justice_League_of_America#JLA_.28January_1997_.E2.80.93_February_2006.29 Justice League]). It was built with the jurisdiction of the United Nations to monitor any suspicious and dangerous activity that could become a serious threat to Earth.

In the DC comics, movies and series, the station was often called two names: the Justice League Satellite and the Justice League Watchtower.
